findings: [Adoptable Interface Choices] The explicit CLI flag `--emit-source6-transfer` (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand.rs:14-22`) gated by the non-default `source6-expansion` Cargo feature (`candidate/crates/mori/Cargo.toml:10-12,42`) cleanly preserves the byte-identical default `moriarty/1` (`moriarty-core/1`) `expand` path (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand.rs:23-29` vs `baseline/crates/mori/src/commands/expand.rs:13-19`), preserves the default Rust beta Core-parser refusal boundary, and fails before file reads with `mori::command::source6-unavailable` when built without `source6-expansion` (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand.rs:37-44`).

[Adoptable Scenario Profile Reuse & Canonical Decimals] Reusing `"profile": "moriarty-local-scenario/1"` and `"kind": "local-stipulation"` as a documented transfer subset (rather than inventing a divergent profile token) is the right design disposition because existing valid transfer scenario fixtures match that exact wire shape (`baseline/packages/moriarty-beta/src/bridge.ts:50-51`, `candidate/crates/mori/tests/fixtures/source6-expansion/invoice.scenario.json:1-19`). Decoding `round`, `balances[*].amount`, `allowance.{remaining,spent}`, `work_remaining`, and `work_spent` via `mori_core::UInt` (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:4,20-41`, `baseline/crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:19-32`) enforces non-empty canonical ASCII decimal strings with no leading zeros in `0..=2^128-1`, matching `uint(v, pointer, U)` in `baseline/packages/moriarty-beta/src/bridge.ts:29-31` and `U128` in `baseline/experiments/moriarty-language/src/successor/financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts:7,173-179`.

[Adoptable Stdout/Stderr/Quiet Success Contract] Writing `expansion.source6.as_bytes()` directly via `write_all` (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:101-104`) emits the raw Source/6 document with its single trailing newline (`candidate/crates/mori-source6/src/transfer.rs:260-267`) and no wrapper JSON or false stage-preparation claim. Emitting `Expanded Source/6 transfer proposal (local-stipulation-only)` via `shell.status` (`candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:105-108`) honors `--quiet` (`baseline/crates/mori/src/shell.rs:41-45`) and satisfies `baseline/RUST_GUIDELINES.md:275-285`.

[Blocker 1 — Inverted Error/Refusal Precedence Between CLI Consumer and Library/Reference Contracts] `candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:80-87` decodes `TransferScenario` from `--scenario` (`line 81`) before invoking `expand_transfer(&source, &input.action, ...)` (`line 87`). This contradicts the candidate library's own docstring (`candidate/crates/mori-source6/src/transfer.rs:64`: `Unsupported operation selection precedes scenario formation`), the expectation specification (`original-library/INDEPENDENT-EXPECTATIONS.md:8`: `a checked repayment or SpecifiedOnly family action must return explicit unsupported-slice diagnostic before scenario shaping; unknown action must return an action-selection diagnostic`), the TypeScript reference consumer (`baseline/packages/moriarty-beta/src/bridge.ts:88-107`, which checks source diagnostics, `BETA_ACTION_UNKNOWN`, and `BETA_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED` with `scenarioValidation: 'NotAppliedUnsupported'` before reading/validating the scenario at line 107), and `UNI-018` (`ADOPTED-REQUIREMENTS.md:11-22`). When a user supplies a valid `repay` or `SpecifiedOnly` family agreement alongside a valid repayment or non-transfer scenario, `source6.rs:81` fails with a serde JSON schema error (`mori::command`) instead of reporting `mori::source6::unsupported_operation` (or source/action diagnostics).

[Blocker 2 — Unreachable Profile/Kind Check and Undiscriminated Subset Refusal in `TransferScenario`] In `candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:11-27,81-86`, `TransferScenario` uses `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` with all 13 transfer fields required before checking `scenario.profile != "moriarty-local-scenario/1" || scenario.kind != "local-stipulation"` at lines 82-86. As a result, (a) passing a scenario from another profile (such as a `moriarty/1` Core scenario `{"state":{},"inputs":{},"balances":[],"liabilities":[]}`) fails inside `serde_json::from_value` at line 81 (`unknown field 'state'`) and never reaches the explicit profile/kind error on lines 82-86; and (b) passing a `moriarty-local-scenario/1` scenario containing `obligation` or `candidate_effects` (admitted by `baseline/packages/moriarty-beta/src/bridge.ts:50,56-63,79-82`) fails as a generic serde unknown-field error instead of an explicit consumer subset refusal naming `obligation` / `candidate_effects` as unsupported by `--emit-source6-transfer` (`UNI-018`, `UNI-019`).

[Blocker 3 — Incomplete Source/6 Formation Checks in `mori-source6` vs `parseAndLowerSource6`] The proposal requires emitted Source/6 text to be valid input to `parseAndLowerSource6` (`proposal/README.md:9`, `candidate/docs/BETA-SOURCE6-EXPANSION.md:26`), which `baseline/packages/moriarty-beta/src/bridge.ts:26,71,220` guarantees by validating identifier syntax, duplicate balance accounts, and calling `parseAndLowerSource6(source6)`. In contrast, `candidate/crates/mori-source6/src/transfer.rs:145-254` and `baseline/crates/mori-checker/src/intents.rs:213-247` omit three formation checks enforced by `baseline/experiments/moriarty-language/spec/successor/financial-agreement-source-v6.md:8-11` and `baseline/experiments/moriarty-language/src/successor/financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts:10-12,92-99,162-165,226,234-235,290-296`: (a) pairwise distinctness of the three transfer account IDs `(terms.owner, terms.recipient, terms.fee_recipient)` (`SOURCE6_CELL_SHAPE`); (b) Source/6 identifier lexical validity (`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$` and exclusion of the 68 Source/6 `RESERVED` words) on `agreement` and entity `.id` strings (`domain`, `asset`, `signer`, `from`, `to`, `fee_to`) which are string literals in `.mori` but emitted unquoted into Source/6; and (c) `scale <= 18` and `valid_from <= valid_to` (`SOURCE6_RANGE`).

[Blocker 4 — Unsanitized Source Filename in Diagnostic Rendering and Missing Guideline/CLI Metadata] In `candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:91-94`, `NamedSource::new(input.file.display().to_string(), source.clone())` omits `crate::display::text(...)` around the filename, unlike `baseline/crates/mori/src/commands/check.rs:125-128`, `baseline/crates/mori/src/error.rs:12,18,24,26`, and `baseline/crates/mori/src/commands/core_io.rs:161`. Additionally, `baseline/RUST_GUIDELINES.md:23-40,271-286` is not updated to document the deliberate differences of `mori expand --emit-source6-transfer` from the TypeScript beta `expand` consumer (`ADOPTED-REQUIREMENTS.md:5`), and `candidate/crates/mori/src/cli.rs:199-200` does not attach a `#[cfg_attr(not(feature = "source6-expansion"), command(after_help = "..."))]` notice to `Command::Expand` as done for other feature-gated subcommands (`candidate/crates/mori/src/cli.rs:194-226`).

summary: Revise-design. The explicit CLI flag (`--emit-source6-transfer`) behind the non-default `source6-expansion` Cargo feature, the reuse of `moriarty-local-scenario/1` (`local-stipulation`) as a documented transfer-only subset with canonical decimal decoding via `mori_core::UInt`, the retention of the byte-identical default `moriarty/1` `expand` path, and the raw Source/6 stdout plus truthful `(local-stipulation-only)` stderr/quiet contract are sound interface choices. However, four concrete source/interface defects block design adoption as written: (1) `crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs:80-87` decodes `TransferScenario` before calling `expand_transfer`, inverting the refusal precedence required by `transfer.rs:64`, `original-library/INDEPENDENT-EXPECTATIONS.md:8`, `bridge.ts:88-107`, and `UNI-018` so that `repay` or `SpecifiedOnly` family actions fail with scenario JSON schema errors instead of `mori::source6::unsupported_operation`; (2) `TransferScenario`'s `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` runs before the `profile`/`kind` check at `source6.rs:81-86`, making the explicit profile error unreachable on non-transfer JSON shapes (including `core.scenario.json` and repayment scenarios) and rejecting `obligation`/`candidate_effects` as generic unknown fields rather than explicit subset refusals; (3) `mori-source6/src/transfer.rs` omits Source/6 formation checks required by `parseAndLowerSource6` (`financial-agreement-source-v6.md:11`, `financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts:10-12,162-165,226,234-235,290-296`), including pairwise-distinct transfer endpoint accounts (`owner`, `recipient`, `fee_recipient`), Source/6 identifier lexical/reserved-word validity on entity `.id` strings, and `scale <= 18` / `valid_from <= valid_to`; and (4) `source6.rs:92` passes `input.file.display().to_string()` to `NamedSource::new` without `crate::display::text(...)` sanitization, and `RUST_GUIDELINES.md` / `cli.rs` lack the documented intentional-difference disposition and subcommand `after_help`.
